name: pragmatic-shared
description: The platform packages shared by the Pragmatic containers: identity contracts, realm services, stores, identity sources, per-realm adapters, component descriptors, component configuration (repository, applied object, runtime reader), the application host, the public-edge contracts (entitlements, ledger, customer API) and the application shell.
